## Products & Services

### 1. Vitrified Tiles
High-density, non-porous tiles manufactured at extremely high temperatures. Available in full-body, glazed and double-charge variants. Frost-resistant and easy to maintain. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor flooring.
- **Finishes**: Matte, polished, satin, carving
- **Typical sizes**: 600×600 mm, 800×800 mm, 1200×600 mm, 1200×1200 mm
- **Best for**: Living rooms, offices, commercial spaces, exterior areas

### 2. Ceramic Tiles
Classic kiln-fired clay tiles glazed with decorative patterns. Affordable, lightweight and available in the widest variety of designs and colours. Easy to cut and install.
- **Finishes**: Gloss, matte, textured
- **Typical sizes**: 300×300 mm, 300×450 mm, 600×300 mm
- **Best for**: Bathrooms, kitchens, feature walls, residential flooring

### 3. Porcelain Tiles
Italian-grade luxury porcelain with ultra-low water absorption (< 0.5%). Extremely hard, scratch-resistant and suitable for heavy residential and commercial use. Looks and feels like natural stone.
- **Finishes**: Matt, polished, structured, lappato
- **Typical sizes**: 600×600 mm, 600×1200 mm, 800×1600 mm
- **Best for**: High-end homes, hotel lobbies, retail showrooms

### 4. Natural Stone Tiles
Authentic tiles cut from natural marble, granite and slate. Each piece is unique with natural veining and texture variation.
- **Types**: Carrara marble, black granite, verde slate, Rajasthan sandstone
- **Finishes**: Honed, polished, brushed, tumbled
- **Best for**: Premium residential interiors, heritage-style exteriors

### 5. Floor Tiles
Engineered specifically for flooring applications — anti-skid surface texture for safety, rated for heavy foot traffic, high abrasion resistance.
- **Rating**: PEI Class 3–5 (medium to heavy traffic)
- **Slip resistance**: R10–R11 anti-skid rating
- **Best for**: Entrance halls, corridors, public spaces, outdoor patios

### 6. Wall Tiles
Lightweight, moisture-resistant tiles designed for vertical surfaces. Available in subway, metro, arabesque, hexagon and panel designs.
- **Moisture resistance**: High (suitable for wet areas)
- **Finishes**: Gloss, satin, 3D embossed
- **Best for**: Bathroom walls, kitchen backsplashes, feature accent walls

## Services

### Free Design Consultation
Our experienced design team offers free in-showroom consultations. We help customers choose tiles that suit their space, budget and aesthetic goals — including colour coordination, pattern mixing and grout colour advice.

### Pan-India Delivery
Royal Tile World ships to all major cities and states across India. Tiles are packed in robust crating to prevent damage during long-distance transit.

### Bulk Order Pricing
We offer volume discounts for builders, architects, interior designers and large residential projects. Contact us for a custom quote.

### After-Sales Support
Our team provides guidance on tile installation, grouting, cleaning and maintenance after purchase.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What types of tiles does Royal Tile World stock?**
A: Royal Tile World stocks vitrified tiles, ceramic tiles, porcelain tiles, natural stone tiles (marble, granite, slate), floor tiles and wall tiles. Over 500 designs are available across all categories.

**Q: Where is the Royal Tile World showroom?**
A: The showroom is located at 123 Tile Market, Industrial Area, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380001, India. It is easily accessible from Ahmedabad city centre.

**Q: What are the showroom opening hours?**
A: Monday to Saturday: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM. Sunday: 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM (IST).

**Q: Does Royal Tile World deliver tiles outside Ahmedabad?**
A: Yes. Royal Tile World provides reliable pan-India delivery. Tiles are packed carefully to prevent breakage during transit.

**Q: Can I get a free design consultation?**
A: Yes. Our expert team offers free design consultations at the showroom. We help you select the right tiles, patterns, sizes and grout combinations for your specific space.

**Q: Are bulk order discounts available?**
A: Yes. We offer special pricing for bulk orders placed by builders, contractors, architects and interior designers. Contact us at +91-98765-43210 or info@royaltileworld.com for a custom quote.

**Q: Are the tiles ISO certified?**
A: Yes. All tiles stocked by Royal Tile World are sourced from manufacturers with ISO certification, ensuring consistent quality and durability.

**Q: What is the price range of tiles?**
A: Royal Tile World caters to all budgets — from affordable ceramic tiles to premium Italian porcelain. Contact us for exact pricing as it varies by material, finish and size.

**Q: How long has Royal Tile World been in business?**
A: Royal Tile World was established in 2010 and has over 15 years of experience in the tile retail industry.

**Q: How many customers has Royal Tile World served?**
A: Royal Tile World has served over 1000 satisfied customers across residential, commercial and hospitality projects.

**Q: What is the best tile for high-traffic areas?**
A: For high-traffic areas, Royal Tile World recommends vitrified or porcelain tiles rated PEI Class 4 or 5, with an anti-skid R10+ surface texture.

**Q: Can I contact Royal Tile World on WhatsApp?**
A: Yes. You can reach us on WhatsApp at +91-98765-43210 or by clicking the WhatsApp button on the website.
